HSK · Level 3 of 6

HSK 3 vocabulary list
all 298 words

HSK 3 adds 298 new words and takes the cumulative syllabus to about 600. This is the level where real conversations begin: work, study, travel and opinions in plain sentences. Every entry shows the hanzi, pinyin with tone marks and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Chinese this list is the HSK 3 pack: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 3 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

02 · Sample sentences

25 words,
each in a sentence

Every word in Lock&Learn Chinese comes with a real example sentence, its reading and a translation, revealed on the tap. Here are 25 from this list.

出现

chūxiàn

to appear or emerge

最近这里出现了很多新商店。

Zuìjìn zhèlǐ chūxiànle hěnduō xīn shāngdiàn.

A lot of new shops have appeared here recently.

带

dài

to carry or bring

今天出门别忘了带伞。

Jīntiān chūmén bié wàngle dài sǎn.

Do not forget to bring an umbrella when you go out today.

地方

dìfang

place or area

这个地方非常漂亮，我们去看看吧。

Zhège dìfang fēicháng piàoliang, wǒmen qù kànkan ba.

This place is very beautiful, let's go take a look.

更

gèng

even more

今年的天气比去年更冷。

Jīnnián de tiānqì bǐ qùnián gèng lěng.

The weather this year is even colder than last year.

公园

gōngyuán

park

我们下午去公园踢足球吧。

Wǒmen xiàwǔ qù gōngyuán tī zúqiú ba.

Let's go to the park to play soccer this afternoon.

护照

hùzhào

passport

请把你的护照拿给我看一下。

Qǐng bǎ nǐ de hùzhào ná gěi wǒ kàn yīxià.

Please show me your passport.

环境

huánjìng

environment or surroundings

这里的学习环境很好。

Zhèlǐ de xuéxí huánjìng hěn hǎo.

The study environment here is very good.

见面

jiànmiàn

to meet someone

我们明天下午两点见面。

Wǒmen míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn jiànmiàn.

We will meet at 2:00 PM tomorrow.

练习

liànxí

to practice or exercise

我每天下午都会练习写汉字。

Wǒ měitiān xiàwǔ dū huì liànxí xiě Hànzì.

I practice writing Chinese characters every afternoon.

楼

lóu

multi-story building

这栋楼里有很多办公室。

Zhè dòng lóu lǐ yǒu hěnduō bàngōngshì.

There are many offices in this building.

帽子

màozi

hat or cap

我买了一顶新的帽子。

Wǒ mǎi le yī dǐng xīn de màozi.

I bought a new hat.

拿

ná

take or hold

你能帮我把那个苹果拿一下吗？

Nǐ néng bāng wǒ bǎ nàge píngguǒ ná yīxià ma?

Could you please help me pick up that apple?

裙子

qúnzi

skirt

这条裙子非常漂亮，我很喜欢。

Zhè tiáo qúnzi fēicháng piàoliang, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.

This skirt is very beautiful, I like it a lot.

然后

ránhòu

then after that

我先买咖啡，然后去上班。

Wǒ xiān mǎi kāfēi, ránhòu qù shàngbān.

I will buy coffee first, then go to work.

上网

shàngwǎng

to go online / to surf the internet

我每天晚上都喜欢上网。

Wǒ měitiān wǎnshang dōu xǐhuan shàngwǎng.

I like to go online every night.

糖

táng

sugar or candy

这块糖非常甜，你吃吗？

Zhè kuài táng fēicháng tián, nǐ chī ma?

This candy is very sweet, would you like some?

体育

tǐyù

sports

我非常喜欢上体育课。

Wǒ fēicháng xǐhuān shàng tǐyù kè.

I really enjoy gym class.

香蕉

xiāngjiāo

banana

我今天在超市买了三根香蕉。

Wǒ jīntiān zài chāoshì mǎi le sān gēn xiāngjiāo.

I bought three bananas at the supermarket today.

爷爷

yéye

paternal grandfather

爷爷经常在公园下棋。

Yéye jīngcháng zài gōngyuán xiàqí.

My grandfather often plays chess in the park.

银行

yínháng

bank

我明天上午要去银行取钱。

Wǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ yào qù yínháng qǔ qián.

I am going to the bank to withdraw money tomorrow morning.

影响

yǐngxiǎng

influence or affect

天气会影响我们的计划。

Tiānqì huì yǐngxiǎng wǒmen de jìhuà.

The weather will affect our plans.

遇到

yùdào

run into someone

我刚才在超市遇到了一位老同学。

Wǒ gāngcái zài chāoshì yùdào le yī wèi lǎo tóngxué.

I just ran into an old classmate at the supermarket.

越

yuè

more and more (often used as 越来越)

天气越来越冷了。

Tiānqì yuè lái yuè lěng le.

The weather is getting colder and colder.

照片

zhàopiàn

photograph or picture

这是我们家以前的照片。

Zhè shì wǒmen jiā yǐqián de zhàopiàn.

This is a picture of my family from before.

字典

zìdiǎn

dictionary

我不认识这个字，请查一下字典。

Wǒ bù rènshi zhège zì, qǐng chá yīxià zìdiǎn.

I do not recognize this character, please look it up in the dictionary.

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the HSK 3 vocabulary list?

298. The six-level HSK syllabus adds about 150, 150, 300, 600, 1,300 and 2,500 new words per level, about 5,000 in all; this page lists the words that are new at HSK 3, not the cumulative total.

Is this the official HSK HSK 3 word list?

It follows the official six-level HSK syllabus (HSK 2.0), the list the HSK 1 to 6 exams are still administered on. The HSK 3.0 standard published in 2021 reorganises vocabulary into nine bands and is not what this page shows.

How do I study the HSK 3 list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. The HSK 3 pack puts these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. HSK 3 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the HSK 3 vocabulary list as a PDF?

Yes. Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF: the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the full table, every word on this list.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
